chapters.label: The free-kick, live
chapters.text: Le Havre, 2019. England play Norway at the World Cup. Free-kick out wide. Beth Mead raises her hand... then cuts it back to Lucy Bronze. First time! Roof of the net!

chapters.label: Arrive late
chapters.text: Watch it again. Nobody marks Bronze. She waits outside the box, then arrives late, just as the ball does.

chapters.label: Through the ball
chapters.text: Knee over the ball, she strikes through it. Past the keeper's hands. Three-nil!

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? Arrive late, so no one can mark you. Plant beside the ball, knee over it, ankle locked, and strike through it first time.
